g.text: Market entry checklist: should we enter, then how
goals, vision, VRIN, SWOT, what we excel at
how many, and what they are doing
target, overlap with rivals, value offer
trade-offs on cost and time to market
write the go/no-go thresholds BEFORE the analysis
example: SOM above Rs X crore in 3 years, break-even within 24 months
the decision is defensible only when the bar was set first
